items.text: Ngenyanga yesikhombisa ngolokuqala lwenyanga kuyakuba khona umhlangano ongcwele kini; ningasebenzi msebenzi; kulusuku lokubethwa kwecilongo kini.
Uyakunikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa ube yiphunga elimnandi kuJehova; ijongosi elilodwa ithole lenkomo, inqama eyodwa, amawundlu angamaduna alomnyaka eyisikhombisa angelasici;
Umnikelo wazo wokudla uyakuba ngempuphu ecolekileyo exovwe namafutha, izingxenye ezintathu zokweshumi ngenkunzi, nokweshumi okubili ngenqama,
nokweshumi kube linye ngewundlu elilodwa kuwo amawundlu ayisikhombisa;
nenqama eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wesono ukunenzela ukubuyisana;

ngaphandle komnikelo wokushiswa wenyanga nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, neminikelo yawo yokuphuzwa, njengokwesimiso sabo, kube yiphunga elimnandi, umnikelo womlilo kuJehova.
Ngosuku lweshumi lwaleyo nyanga yesikhombisa kuyakuba khona umhlangano ongcwele kini; futhi niyothobisa imiphefumulo yenu; ningasebenzi msebenzi ngayo.
Kepha uyakunikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa kuJehova, ube yiphunga elimnandi; ijongosi elilodwa, inqama eyodwa, amawundlu angamaduna ayisikhombisa anomnyaka munye; ziyakuba ngenasici kuwe.
Umnikelo wazo wokudla uyakuba yimpuphu ecolekileyo exovwe namafutha, izingxenye ezintathu zokweshumi ngenkunzi, nokweshumi okubili ngenqama inye,
okweshumi okuyingcosana ngewundlu elilodwa kuwo amawundlu ayisikhombisa;
inqama eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo wesono wokubuyisana, nomnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, neminikelo yawo yokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lweshumi nanhlanu lwenyanga yesikhombisa kuyakuba khona umbuthano ongcwele kini; aniyikwenza msebenzi wakukhonza, nibe nomkhosi wokudumisa uJehova izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Kumelwe unikele ngomnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi kuJehova; izinkunzi eziyishumi nantathu, nezinqama ezimbili, nezimvu zamawundlu eziyishumi nane; bayakuba ngenasici.
Umnikelo wazo wokudla uyakuba yimpuphu ecolekileyo exovwe namafutha, okweshumi okuthathu ngenkunzi ezinkunzana eziyishumi nantathu, nokweshumi okubili ngenqama kuzo zombili izinqama,
Nokweshumi ngewundlu ngalinye kumawundlu ayishumi nane;
nezinyane elilodwa libe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesibili niyakunikela ngezinkunzi eziyishumi nambili, nezinqama ezimbili, namawundlu angamaduna ayishumi nane, amnyaka mnye angenasici.
Umnikelo wako wokudla neminikelo yako yokuphuzwayo yezinkunzi, izinqama namawundlu, kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokwesimiso.
Nenqama ibe nye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, neminikelo yawo yokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesithathu izinkunzi eziyishumi nanye, nezinqama ezimbili, namawundlu amawundlu aneminyaka eyishumi nane, angenasici;
Umnikelo wako wokudla neminikelo yako yokuphuzwayo yezinkunzi, izinqama namawundlu, kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokwesiko.
Nempongo ibe nye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesine izinkunzi eziyishumi, nezinqama ezimbili, namawundlu angamaduna aneminyaka eyishumi nane, angenasici;
Umnikelo wazo wokudla neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo yezinkunzi, izinqama namawundlu, kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokuvumelana nokusetshenziswa kwazo.
Nezinyane elilodwa libe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesihlanu izinkunzi eziyisishiyagalolunye, nezinqama ezimbili, nezimvu zamawundlu ezineminyaka eyishumi nane ezingenasici;
Umnikelo wako wokudla neminikelo yako yokuphuzwayo yezinkunzi, izinqama namawundlu, kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokwesimiso.
Nempongo ibe nye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesithupha izinkunzi eziyisishiyagalombili, izinqama ezimbili, nezimvu zamawundlu ezineminyaka eyishumi nane ezingenasici;
Umnikelo wako wokudla neminikelo yako yokuphuzwayo yezinkunzi, izinqama namawundlu, kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokwesimiso.
Nempongo ibe nye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa izinkunzi eziyisikhombisa, izinqama ezimbili, nezimvu zamawundlu ezineminyaka eyishumi nane ezingenasici;
Umnikelo wako wokudla neminikelo yako yokuphuzwayo yezinkunzi, izinqama namawundlu, kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokwesimiso.
Nempongo ibe nye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili niyakuba nomkhosi;
Niyakunikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuJehova: inkunzi eyodwa, nenqama, namawundlu ayisikhombisa amnyaka munye, angenasici;
Umnikelo wako wokudla neminikelo yako yokuphuzwayo yenkunzi, inqama namawundlu kumelwe kube ngokwesibalo sakho, ngokwesimiso.
Nempongo ibe nye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, nomnikelo wawo wempuphu, nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwa.

Lezizinto niyakuzenza kuJehova emikhosini yenu, ngaphandle kwezithembiso zenu, neminikelo yenu yesihle, neminikelo yenu yokushiswa, neminikelo yenu yempuphu, neminikelo yenu yokuphuzwa, neminikelo yenu yokubonga.
UMose wabatshela abantwana bakwa-Israyeli, njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
